thread:
maria: FYI — Acme just requested Voyager-13B for private deployment (HIPAA scope). They want low-latency chat, predictable latency SLOs. Can we triage and slot a smoke/compat run?
raj: Quick clarifying q: model format + preferred quant target? Also perf SLOs and sequence length?
maria: Artifact is HF repo + checkpoints. FP16 baseline available. Customer prefers 4-bit quant (GPTQ) if quality holds. Seq_len ~2048 typical, target ~120 tok/s per GPU, p95 <120ms. NDA inbound.
anya: OK. I can run baseline evals and compare. Need link to artifacts + sample inference call. Is the model HF-compatible natively?
ciara: I'll take quant/bench. Planning to spin up dev-gpu-02 for conversion/quantrun. ETA ~48h for initial 4-bit pass. @quant-bot can you queue a GPTQ-4 run?
quant-bot: Job queued: q-7834 -> pipeline: convert->gptq(4bit)->perf-smoke->report. Estimated runtime ~3h once dev-gpu-02 is free. Will post logs to thread.
raj: Infra notes: private deployment will need KMS/HSM + VPC image. @deploy-bot can you pre-provision an onboarding image and open a KMS ticket? Also need expected memory footprint after quant.
deploy-bot: Received. Please provide model checksum and a sample inference call for the perf harness. I'll reserve a VPC slot pending artifacts.
maria: Uploading artifacts now to s3://acme/voyager13b/ (will share perms). Sample curl for perf harness: ```
curl -X POST https://redwood.local/private/voyager13b/infer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"Hello, how can I help?","max_tokens":64,"stream":false}'
```
anya: For eval plan: I'll run 500 prompt testset from Acme, compare FP16 baseline -> GPTQ4 metrics (ROUGE/EM/QA accuracy + hallucination rate). If drop >2% absolute we consider 8-bit or QLoRA remediation.
ciara: Noted. If quant loss looks large I'll try alternative recipes (per-channel, fallback to 8-bit). Triage priority: high-customer.
maria: Assigning owners: ciara (quant + bench), anya (evals/quality gating), raj (infra + deployment). I'll DM NDA and confirm timeline with Acme.
ciara: :thumbsup: kicking off conversion now, will post q-7834 logs and early perf snapshot here when done.
quant-bot: q-7834 started on dev-gpu-02. Logging -> https://logs.redwood.internal/q-7834 (will update status).
notes: Customer-driven onboarding, HIPAA scope, priority=high-customer, owners assigned. Follow-ups: artifact perms, NDA, KMS ticket, and quant/eval reports.
